A-进口贸易商.subject: Used Truck Tires Wholesale — Direct from China Factory
A-进口贸易商.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

We are a leading Chinese supplier of used truck tires (HS 4012.20) with 15+ years export experience to West & East Africa.

Specifications available:
- 11R22.5 / 315/80R22.5 (drive position)
- 1000R20 / 1100R20 (mixed road)
- Mining specs 13R22.5
- TBR / LTR / OTR mix grades

We ship 40HQ containers weekly from Shanghai/Tianjin to Lagos/Apapa, Mombasa, Tema. Payment terms: TT 30% deposit, balance against copy of B/L. CIF Lagos USD price negotiable by spec.

Catalog and recent SGS inspection report attached.

Can we send you our latest price list for September?

Best regards,
Sales Team
FANSHIHAO International Trading (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.

C-车队/矿企/物流.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,
